data.title: Pixel Modern Office
data.summary: Free 3D pixel art office kit: modular walls, desks, chairs, meeting rooms, break room, server rack and posed workers.
data.description: A complete modern office floor as chunky pixel art game assets, ready for Unity, Godot, Unreal, three.js and Blender. Walls, glazed partitions, floor and ceiling tiles sit on a 2 m room grid with a 2.8 m storey and declared edge ports, so a floor plate assembles square. Workstations, meeting rooms, the break room, server and storage and twenty decor pieces dress it, including six posed workers on one shared chunky body. Doors, drawers, the lift leaves, the scanner lid, the standing desk top and the clock hands are named nodes on real pivots and ship rigid open and close clips; there is no skinning anywhere and the posed figures have no rig or skeleton. Every surface carries a 32 px nearest-filtered map over a shared palette of warm white, light oak, charcoal, slate blue, sage, coral, mustard and screen cyan. Metres, +Y up, +Z front, CC0.
